answer: New seats enter through one inlet and are moored by beacon lottery into crews of eight strangers, like boats handed random berths at a wharf. Each crew posts one pooled bond; if a member is later proven a clone, the bond burns for all, except members who flagged it before the audit, who are refunded. A farm cannot pick its crewmates, so a 100-seat farm sits beside 700 honest strangers with money riding on spotting it. Watching seven crewmates is cheap, and one sparrow that sees the hawk saves the flock.
